sloka: निश्चित एक अन्त चित्तस्य कार्य निश्चय दर्शिनी ।कामम् दृष्ट्वा मया सर्वा विश्वस्ता रावण स्त्रियः ॥५-११-४०॥
transliteration: niścita eka anta cittasya kārya niścaya darśinī ।kāmam dṛṣṭvā mayā sarvā viśvastā rāvaṇa striyaḥ ॥5-11-40॥

translations.english: 'It is true I saw all the loyal wives of Ravana but without any foul desire. Indeed in my mind no passionate feeling was ever aroused'.
